decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (197/001 Rev. P1, 197/002 Rev. P2, 197/003 Rev. P4, Design and Access Statement prepared by TFF architects Ltd dated 23 June 2016, Flood Risk Assessment prepared by Hydro-logic Services reference K0658/ACD and dated 26 August 2015, Basement Method Statement prepared by JG Partnership reference RW169 Issue No.1,  dated June 2016. Received on 27 June 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the Construction Method Statement submitted with this application; no excavation or construction work shall be undertaken prior to the submission and approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority, of a detailed Construction Method Statement certified by a qualified professional, giving details of excavation, temporary works and construction techniques, including details of potential impacts on neighbouring land based on assessment of the geology and hydrology of the area.

Condition : 4 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - An arboricultural report showing the impacts and proposed mitigation measures to protect the London Plane tree to the front of the property shall be submitted in writing and approved by the Local Planning Authority before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development.

Condition : 7 - The development hereby permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment and the basement shall not be occupied until all the measures in the Flood Risk Assessment are implemented.
Condition : 8 - The basement shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.
description: Extension of existing basement and creation of a lightwell to the front of the property.
